page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ine.2xlarge is an x86_64 compute instance belonging to the Enhanced ecs.c8ine family. Built on KVM hypervisor technology, this server is driven by an Intel Xeon Sapphire Rapids processor operating at a baseline clock speed of 2.7 GHz. It allocates 8 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of main memory, resulting in a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU core. This hardware layout emphasizes processing density relative to RAM capacity.

The instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring attached network volumes for operating system and data storage requirements. Network performance is backed by a 12 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The system includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses and contains no integrated GPU accelerators.

With dedicated CPU allocation, the resource profile eliminates resource contention, providing deterministic compute performance for continuous execution. The low memory-to-vCPU ratio establishes a cost-efficient deployment profile for CPU-bound pipelines, software compilation, web serving, microservices, and batch execution tasks where high RAM volume or local drives are unnecessary.
